newsitem.title: JAPAN: Gajoen Kanko shares to be suspended from trade - TSE.
newsitem.headline: Gajoen Kanko shares to be suspended from trade - TSE.

text.p: Trading of shares in Gajoen Kanko KK was suspended for the whole of Tuesday's afternoon session, the Tokyo Stock Exchange said.
The suspension is due to unclear information after a report that the firm failed to honour promissory notes, the TSE said.
Earlier on Tuesday, Japanese credit research company Teikoku Databank said that the Japanese hotel operator had failed to pay the notes for the second time, with debts totalling 9.88 billion yen.
